name: Dashboard stats climb as live sale toasts arrive
looks: A dark analytics card shows three stat columns (clicks, leads, sales) that roll up together from empty to their current values, a line chart beneath them drawing left to right with a travelling end-point. As the numbers finish, small toast cards slide in from the right naming individual new leads and sales as they happen.
build: data-infographic drives the three stat tiles and the chart's progressive draw; the toasts slide/fade in on their own short stagger after the chart finishes, each holding a beat before the next arrives, so the dashboard reads as alive rather than a static report.
sound: A rising tone under the stat roll-ups, a soft whoosh under the chart draw, and a light chime per toast.
prompt: Show an analytics dashboard as alive, not static: roll up a row of headline numbers together, draw a chart beneath them left to right, then let small toast notifications slide in naming individual real events as they happen, proving the numbers above are still moving.
